newsitem.title: DENMARK: Goldman advises Tele Danmark on share purchase.
newsitem.headline: Goldman advises Tele Danmark on share purchase.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark said on Tuesday that it had appointed Goldman Sachs International to advise it over the state's plan to sell all or part of its 51.73 percent holding.
The company said last week that it could buy some of the shares if the possibility arises, although the government has so far not said how, when or to what extent it plans to sell.
A report from its advisors is expected in September.
Tuesday's Tele Danmark statement said that at current prices the total market value of the group's equity was about 45 billion crowns. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
